unavailable.reason: The reference builds the question inline in `app.py:_ask_push_approval` and answers it through the app-server user-question flow, so capturing it would require mounting the whole Vibe App with a live client.
The reference widget consumes an async login stream from the app server; the oracle can only pin its rendered states, not the transport itself.
